_comment: Krea-2 (K2) SFT ANNEAL after merging the two v2 mass-LoRA banks (e621 bank_step_12200 + danbooru bank_step_11700, 512 slots pooled) with experiments/merge_lora_bank.py --method normmatch --tau 1.0 into the fullft_step_49600 base. tau 1.0 chosen (user decision 2026-09-05): tau 2.0 showed destabilised previews; tau-2 file deleted once the tau-1 run passed smoke. Full fine-tune (mode 'full') on the SAME two booru sources and caption mix the banks were trained on, at a low anneal LR (5e-6, below the 1.732e-5 full-FT default) so the merged delta settles into the weights without burning the model. See runs/k2-sft-v2bank-anneal/merge_t10.log for the merge command and structure report.
_comment_split: chunks_per_stage null = balance by weight bytes. Same as train_pipeline_full.json.
_comment_batch: batch_size is PER MICROBATCH; effective batch = 1 * 8 = 8. Full FT keeps ~65 GB/GPU of fp32 masters+grads+AdamW; grad_ckpt on.
_comment_ckpt: Merged base (normmatch tau 1.0 pooled 512 slots). full_checkpoint > lora_checkpoint > mmdit_checkpoint resume priority; here it is a plain full model so it loads via mmdit_checkpoint.
_comment_mode: full mode resume priority: full_checkpoint > lora_checkpoint (merged into mmdit_checkpoint) > mmdit_checkpoint.

parquet_dataloader._comment_captions: Same caption_columns as the two bank configs: all five bands a row has, one drawn per visit (banks re-normalize the weights per row; plain train.py samples per row at load). tags and midjourney_style_summary at 2x, prose bands at 1x; only 'tags' is tag_based.
